newsitem.title: USA: Deltapoint names AIT as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Deltapoint names AIT as CEO.

text.p: DeltaPoint Inc, a developer of Internet and graphics software, on Wednesday said it named Jeffrey Ait as its chief executive officer replacing John Ambrose, who stepped down to pursue other interests.
Ait was formerly the vice president, Internet for The Santa Cruz Operation Inc, a software company focused on developing products for the Unix operating system.

At Santa Cruz Operation, Ait was responsible for developing and driving that company's worldwide Internet strategy and direction. He launched its Internet products to both domestic and international markets.

Prior to his tenure at Santa Cruz Operation, Ait was the vice president of Major Business Opportunities at Government Technology Services Inc. Previously, he directed the national reseller program for Unisys Corp, after serving in various managerial capacities for computer systems companies.
Ait has more than 16 years of management experience in the computer industry.
